description: This file defines the SiloProviderRuntime class, which implements IProviderRuntime and provides methods for managing grain extensions and access to grain-related services within the Orleans runtime system.

classes.name: SiloProviderRuntime
classes.description: An internal class implementing IProviderRuntime, facilitating grain extension management and service access within Orleans.
